about: I'm Nisith Saha, and I'm passionate about AWS Cloud, DevOps, Networking and Blockchain Technology. I completed my B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering in 2019. I have expertise in Amazon Web Services, Cloud Computing, DevOps, Automation, Infrastructure as Code, Solution Architecture, Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Network & Security, Python, Linux and much more. I am an AWS Certified Engineer holding 6 AWS certifications. Currently working as a Cloud Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services with 7+ years of experience in the IT industry. I am also an AWS Community Builder and an active learner, with a growing interest in AI and Generative AI.
